summary: Plan user adoption, assess workflow impacts and report rollout progress. Explore this five-day digital change management course.
lede: Digital change management helps project leads, people managers and transformation teams plan how people adopt new systems and workflows. Using ADKAR and Kotter’s change frameworks, participants practise mapping role impacts, comparing current and future workflows, and tracking signals such as active use and task completion. They also develop role-based support plans and review adoption barriers to inform rollout decisions.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits people who coordinate digital change or carry responsibility for helping teams use new systems and workflows. It is designed for professionals who need practical planning tools rather than technical system configuration.
prerequisites: No formal change-management qualification is required. Familiarity with workplace digital systems or process changes will help you connect the exercises to your role. Coding and system configuration are not required.
